OpPayload.description: Operation inputs. No property is required at the spec level; the bridge validates inputs and returns a structured error when something is missing. Ops that act on jobs accept state_dir; when omitted the server uses its own state root.

OpResult.description: Every operation returns a JSON object with an ok boolean. Failures return ok false with an error code and message; nothing is ever published or approved by these operations.

ApiKeyAuth.description: Server API key (ERUDIANCE_API_KEY). Sent as the X-Api-Key header on every operation call.
ApiKeyAuth.name: X-Api-Key

info.description: Run-only front end for the Erudiance LinkedIn content and image workflow (plugin v4.9.2). ChatGPT may run automation through these operations only. It cannot approve, publish, schedule, or change code, config, or brand policy. Owner approval (submit_owner_decision) is intentionally NOT part of this API: only the owner decides, outside ChatGPT.
info.title: Erudiance Automation API

200.description: Service is up. chatgpt_connected stays false until a real ChatGPT request succeeds through the deployed server.

post.summary: Execute one authorized workflow step (state_dir, step, operator). Cannot approve or publish.
Per-agent report for a workflow or job (state_dir, optional content_id).
Content metadata preview (content_hash, caption, image_path, image_sha256). Metadata only; visually_verified is always false.
Image metadata preview (image_path, image_sha256, dimensions). Metadata only; visually_verified is always false.
Bridge/gate/batch versions, provider statuses, approval state. Never claims CONNECTED.
Status of a workflow or a single job (state_dir, optional content_id).
The 18 specialist agent roles and their contracts.
Resume a workflow from its checkpoint (state_dir, content_id, operator). Gates are never skipped.
Start a 7-job LinkedIn workflow. Payload: topics (7 distinct strings), cycle (string), state_dir, operator. Default mode TEST_FIXTURE unless mode LIVE is given. Runs automation only.
Validate a content item against the brand/gate rules (item, optional artifacts). Returns a decision, never publishes.
Validate an image file (image_path). Returns the pixel inspection result.

servers.description: Replace with the deployed server URL after deployment. Until then this spec is not callable by ChatGPT.
